__comment: Player Shop. The pattern maps onto the block itself: glass window on top, chest of stock in the middle, cash in the dispense slot at the bottom, iron cabinet down both sides. The $20 bill is the point — opening a business costs money, and it puts the block behind the economy rather than beside it. Ore-dict entries (not hard item ids) so pack-added iron/glass/chests work too. Server Shop is deliberately uncraftable: it's an operator fixture, handed out with /give.
